briefTitle: A Study to Evaluate the Efficacy of Pumitamig Versus Pembrolizumab in Participants With Previously Untreated Advanced Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer and PD-L1 ≥ 50%. (ROSETTA Lung-202)

typedChecks.sourceText: Participants must have a histologically or cytologically confirmed diagnosis of Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC) (squamous and nonsquamous) with Stage IIIB/IIIC or Stage IV disease.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants must have measurable disease as defined by Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors (RECIST) v1.1.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Measurable disease by RECIST is a subjective imaging judgment, not a typed kind.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants must have no prior systemic anti-tumor therapy for locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants must not have any documented actionable genomic alteration (AGA) for which first-line (1L) approved therapies are indicated.
